description:
Do you want to change how the world creates?

 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

 Join a small, scrappy team driving Form Now , our new print-on-demand service that brings professional 3D printing to customers faster and more affordably than ever. You'll design and build the software powering our Form Now website and production line, solve complex technical problems, and play a key role in launching a new class of 3D printing at scale.

 What You’ll Do: 

 
 Develop and implement core software features for the Form Now print-on-demand service.

 Architect and build the next generation of factory software, including our custom Manufacturing Execution System (MES).

 Create robust backend code using Python/Django, and user-facing frontend code with Next.js and React.js.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with factory operators, product managers, and leadership to define and deliver new features and integrations.

 Take full ownership of your projects, from initial scoping and development to testing, implementation, and ongoing support.

 Maintain and improve our existing codebase, ensuring reliability and scalability in a production environment.

 
 About You: 

 
 You have a proven track record as a Full-stack Web Developer with experience in a production environment.

 You are an entrepreneurial and flexible problem-solver, comfortable navigating ambiguity and thriving in a fast-paced, agile development environment.

 You work autonomously, moving quickly from idea to implementation, and aren’t afraid to experiment, iterate, and refine solutions based on what you learn.

 You enjoy taking ownership of projects and seeing them through to completion.

 You possess strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 You are willing to work on-site in Billerica, MA as needed to test, debug, and release factory software.

 
 Bonus Skills:  

 
 Experience with 3D models, processing, or analysis.

 Experience with web development in a mixed local/cloud hybrid setup.

 Background working with hardware or equipment, or an appreciation for the bridge between software and the physical world.

 Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD.

 Familiarity with data engineering and dashboarding tools.

 
 Curious what it’s like to build software at Formlabs? Get a closer look in this short interview with senior leader Max King. 

 

 Our Benefits & Perks: 

 
 Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

 Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors 

 Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

 Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

 Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

 Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

 Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

 Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

 Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

 And of course… unlimited 3D prints

 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.   

 Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

  
 Compensation 
 

 Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

 Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

 The annual base pay range for this role is:
 $110,000 — $145,000 USD
